name: AnalyseEvents2
description: On-the-fly event analyser — segments percussive material into events using an onset detector and writes per-event analysis data into a buffer. Best used indirectly via Segmentation (one-pass) or AnalyseEventsDatabase (on-the-fly) classes from the bbcut2 quark; not recommended for direct use. From sc3-plugins BBCut2UGens.

inputs.name: bufnum
inputs.description: Buffer index where event analysis results are written

inputs.name: threshold
inputs.description: Onset detector threshold (the default was empirically best on a percussive-onset database)

inputs.name: triggerid
inputs.description: Trigger ID for SendTrig-style notification of new events to the language (on-the-fly only)

inputs.name: circular
inputs.description: If 1, treat the buffer as circular (on-the-fly analysis). 0 for one-pass analysis

inputs.name: pitch
inputs.description: Optional kr pitch detector — if connected, the median fundamental over each event is recorded

name: DrumTrack
description: Cross-correlation search and drum-pattern matching beat tracker designed for acoustic drum kits and pop signals with drums. Tempi 90-190 bpm. Outputs 4 channels: ticks at quarter, eighth and sixteenth note levels plus the current detected tempo. See Collins 'Drum Track: Beat Induction from an Acoustic Drum Kit with Synchronised Scheduling' (ICMC 2005). From sc3-plugins BBCut2UGens.

inputs.name: lock
inputs.description: If > 0.5, lock the tracker to current periodicity/phase. Set back below 0.5 to resume tracking

inputs.name: dynleak
inputs.description: Leaky-integrator coefficient in the causal dynamic-programming search

inputs.name: prior
inputs.description: Index of a 100-element float buffer of tempo prior weights (90..189 bpm in 1 bpm steps), or negative for a flat prior

inputs.name: kicksensitivity
inputs.description: Multiplier on the kick-drum detector's sensitivity (1.0 = default; lower = more sensitive)

inputs.name: snaresensitivity
inputs.description: Multiplier on the snare-drum detector's sensitivity

inputs.name: debugmode
inputs.description: 0 = silent; 1 = post pattern matches and phase/period transitions; 2 = also post each kick/snare detection
